title: My honest opinion on Ox Alpha for design: Please give it a try.
author: Morpegom
selftext:
[Ox Alpha design.](https://preview.redd.it/sjq7xefu4jlh1.png?width=1600&format=png&auto=webp&s=562ed65a392ce2a239ae17b841db7a5dc2ca0232)

[Sol High design.](https://preview.redd.it/qc3hozsq4jlh1.png?width=1600&format=png&auto=webp&s=29f6f5e8af7211b637e0ccacc0714c3745ba8d72)

Yes I'm building yet another roguelite game. The code on this part of the game was made by myself, but since I'm terrible at design/front end, I asked AI to do it for me.

I swear I'm not here to start a war: Some LLMs are way better than others doing a thing or another. But thank god Ox Alpha was here in the right time.

The prompt was the same for both, but Ox Alpha could already look at Sols work and maybe feel like I didnt like it (since I asked for a full redesign) and have a head start. Regardless:

>Create a polished retro pixel-art game interface for a progression screen. Use your design judgment for the layout, boss card arrangement, hierarchy, and color accents. Include the top status bar already coded, connected progression path with case cards and prices, and strong bottom navigation buttons. Use crisp pixel typography, beveled panels, subtle CRT texture, and a cohesive game-ready presentation.

And honestly I was shocked. I don't hate Sol, it helped more to set footing in my game than I ever could, but for a LLM thats supposed to be cheaper (its free for a few more days, but will obviously gonna cost money) it really gets the point. 

My take is: Give it a try. I'm not being paid to post this so Ill not get into any further details, but so far all I wanted was for it to be free for the entirety of september.
